source_note: Conservative, qualitative renal-dosing decision support compiled from standard nephrology references. eGFR is ESTIMATED from CKD stage, not measured. Verify every recommendation against a current renal dosing reference (e.g. the Renal Drug Handbook or the product label) and a pharmacist before acting.

drugs.name: digoxin
drugs.recommendation: Reduce maintenance dose and/or extend the dosing interval; monitor serum digoxin level and potassium. Accumulates as eGFR falls — toxicity risk rises in CKD.

drugs.name: furosemide
drugs.renal_handling: loop diuretic; not dose-reduced in CKD
drugs.recommendation: No routine dose reduction — loop diuretics often require HIGHER doses as eGFR falls. Monitor electrolytes and volume status; furosemide-induced hypokalaemia/hypomagnesaemia potentiates digoxin toxicity.

drugs.name: metformin
drugs.renal_handling: renally cleared; lactic-acidosis risk in renal impairment
drugs.recommendation: Reassess dose at eGFR <45 and do not initiate; discontinue at eGFR <30 due to lactic-acidosis risk.

drugs.name: gabapentin
drugs.recommendation: Dose-reduce in proportion to eGFR; accumulation causes sedation, ataxia and CNS toxicity in CKD.

drugs.name: pregabalin
drugs.recommendation: Reduce dose per eGFR; risk of sedation/CNS depression with accumulation.

drugs.name: ibuprofen
drugs.recommendation: Avoid NSAIDs in CKD: risk of acute kidney injury, hyperkalaemia, fluid retention and reduced diuretic efficacy. Prefer paracetamol.

drugs.name: naproxen
drugs.recommendation: Avoid NSAIDs in CKD: AKI, hyperkalaemia and reduced diuretic response. Prefer paracetamol.

drugs.name: diclofenac
drugs.recommendation: Avoid NSAIDs in CKD — nephrotoxicity and hyperkalaemia risk.

drugs.name: atenolol
drugs.recommendation: Accumulates in renal impairment — reduce dose; consider a hepatically-cleared beta-blocker (e.g. metoprolol, bisoprolol).

drugs.name: allopurinol
drugs.recommendation: Reduce dose per eGFR and titrate to urate; accumulation increases hypersensitivity/toxicity risk.

drugs.name: nitrofurantoin
drugs.recommendation: Avoid at eGFR <30 — inadequate urinary levels (ineffective) plus increased systemic toxicity (neuropathy, pulmonary).

drugs.name: spironolactone
drugs.recommendation: Hyperkalaemia risk in CKD — avoid or use only with close potassium monitoring at eGFR <30.

drugs.name: enoxaparin
drugs.recommendation: Reduce treatment dose and/or monitor anti-Xa at eGFR <30 — accumulation increases bleeding risk.

drugs.name: lisinopril
drugs.recommendation: Monitor potassium and creatinine after initiation/uptitration; expect a small creatinine rise. Withhold during acute illness/volume depletion (sick-day rules).

drugs.name: ciprofloxacin
drugs.recommendation: Reduce dose / extend interval at eGFR <30.

drugs.name: tramadol
drugs.recommendation: Extend dosing interval / reduce dose at eGFR <30 — accumulation of active metabolite increases sedation and seizure risk.

disclaimer: Decision support only — not a substitute for clinical judgement. eGFR here is ESTIMATED from CKD stage, not measured; actual dosing depends on measured renal function, weight, indication and the specific product. Verify against a current renal dosing reference and consult a pharmacist.
